criterion: Parsing (obsolete and removed in WCAG 2.2; historical WCAG 2.1 reference)
description: Historical reference only: this was a Level A criterion in WCAG 2.1 and is marked obsolete and removed in WCAG 2.2, so it is not a current WCAG 2.2 requirement; Level A here is only its historical classification. The WCAG 2.1 text asked for complete start and end tags; elements nested according to their specifications; no duplicate attributes; unique IDs; except where the specifications allow these features. WCAG 2.1 Note 1 says it should be considered always satisfied for HTML or XML content. W3C says many issues that would have failed it now fail 1.3.1 or 4.1.2 instead. WCAG 2.1 text: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG21/#parsing
techniques: Historical WCAG 2.1 techniques: G134 Validating web pages; G192 Fully conforming to specifications
failures: Historical WCAG 2.1 failures: F70 incorrect use of start and end tags or attribute markup; F77 duplicate values of type ID
